DIRECTOR AND THE STAFF OF THE INSTITUTE
175. (1) There shall be a Director of the Institute appointed
by  the  Minister,  in  consultation  with  the  Institute  Board.
The Director, unless he vacates office earlier by death, by
operation of law, resignation or removal shall hold office for
a term of five years and shall be eligible for reappointment
subject  to  a  maximum  period  of  any  two  terms  of  office
